# Included processes
This module includes the European production of liquid packaging board (LPB) in an integrated mill - including transports to paper mill, wood handling, chemical pulping, board production, energy production on-site and internal waste water treatment.; Geography: Data from the former Swiss packaging study and from several CER used as European average data.
